title: Single File Upload
description: Build a single file upload system with a form, multipart upload endpoint, and file retrieval by name.

steps.title: Upload form page
steps.description: Serve an HTML form at GET /upload-form that allows users to select a file and submit it via POST to /upload.
hints: Include a file input and submit button

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
@app.get('/upload-form', response_class=HTMLResponse)
def upload_form():
    return '<form action="/upload" method="POST" enctype="multipart/form-data"><input type="file" name="file"><button type="submit">Upload</button></form>'

steps.title: Upload endpoint
steps.description: Implement POST /upload that accepts a multipart file upload, stores the file in memory, and returns 200 with file info (name, size, type).
hints: Use multer (npm) for JS/TS file parsing
Store file in an in-memory map

steps.title: File download endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /files/:name that retrieves and returns a previously uploaded file by its name with the correct Content-Type and status 200.
hints: Look up the file by name in the in-memory store
Set Content-Type header to the file's mimetype
